profile.headline: Senior full stack developer and programmer analyst. Currently preparing for the CISSP certification in 2024!
profile.summary:
Currently preparing for the CISSP certification in 2024!

Experienced full-stack developer with a demonstrated history of working on projects in the healthcare, higher education, finance, and telecommunications industries. With over 10 years of experience, I've developed web applications on the .NET and LAMP platforms with multiple databases, API integrations, and responsive web design.

My technical skills include, but not limited to, C#, ASP.NET (Web Forms, MVC, Core), Microsoft SQL Server, as well as open-source platforms using Angular.js/Angular, Laravel (PHP/MySQL, LAMP), and Java (JDBC, Oracle).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:
•	Provide primary support for changes & development for web enabled systems and applications.
•	Works with co-located and distributed teams to implement and provide support to in-house or SAAS applications.
•	Implement security policies that comply with corporate standards and IT best practices.
•	Performs audits on existing in-house and SAAS applications.
•	Supports Extract, Transform, Load (ETL), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Business Intelligence (BI) tools.
•	Provides back-end support for functional testing and performance testing of existing applications within a virtualized environment.
•	Develops and implements patches using programming skills for web based, mobility and fat client applications.
•	Develops and overview understanding of the overall systems landscape and provides mapping between environments.
•	Engages application vendors using methodological troubleshooting techniques in order to provide fixes.
•	Manages patches and changes controls of systems.
•	Engages company staff and stakeholders in order to gather business requirements for existing and new applications and systems.
•	Develops scripts to migrate data from multiple sources.
•	Supports and maintains systems in a virtualized environment.

positions.title: Database Administrator - Assistant
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:
•	Designs, builds, develops, supports and maintains all of VON’s databases within its operating environment.
•	Designs, develops, and implements database infrastructure including server, security, communication and database structures
•	Creates logical and physical data models in conjunction with database developer(s) and application developer(s), creating physical database or other data storage designs, enabling query executions, and testing of preliminary designs, to assist in eliminating later problems
•	Tests and installs new database, application and other DBMS software before promotion to production, ensuring only valid data is entered into the new database
•	Plans and executes the migration of data from other environments, including legacy data and obsolete server based databases, into new database environments
•	Designs, develops and implements workflow and technical processes for automation of data flows between data sources, data marts, and analytic tools
•	Tunes databases to maximize performance, using up-to-date tools and techniques
•	Monitors and tune SQL Server database performance, investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving query and database performance issues
•	Implements formal database back-up routines and schedules and similar processes to recover from back-ups in whole or in part in the event of catastrophic loss.
•	Assists IT/IS staff in developing and testing disaster and business recovery plans.
•	Monitors and analyzes database performance against standards and provides improvement solutions, monitors data growth, demand changes and storage migrations and develops capacity plans
•	Supports, monitors, and controls VON’s database development environments, to ensure compliance with database and application development best practices
•	Supports VON network and security staff to ensure integrity of database security
•	Documents the changes in VON database environments, including post implementation support documentation

positions.title: Web Developer / SQL Support Specialist
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:
•	Provide primary support for changes & development for web enabled systems and supporting database environments (PHP, ASP.NET, HTML, MySQL, MSSQL)
•	Administer, modify and maintain a Drupal 7.x based environment and a .NET based intranet
•	Administer and provide SQL Server database (2008 – 2017) support and maintenance 
•	Develop stored procedures, triggers and/or user defined functions (UDFs) to facilitate business functions
•	Monitor and tune SQL Server database performance
•	Provide Transact-SQL statement tuning and optimize data loading processes
•	Work with team members to implement optimum physical database design architecture
•	Maintain day-to-day operating procedures for SQL server databases
•	Prepare database growth projections and plan for storage capacity
•	Develop and maintain web application server and database standards with support documentation
•	Implement security policies as set out by corporate standards
•	Provide back-end support for functional testing and performance testing of web-based environment
•	Develop scripts to migrate data from multiple sources
•	Prepare database and web application system backup and recovery processes and rehearse disaster recovery plans
•	Design and implement clustered databases and web hosts with fail-over capabilities
•	Support and maintain systems in a virtualized environment

positions.title: ASP.NET Web Developer
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:
•	Develop and maintain multi-tenant applications across the entire stack, including front end, business layer, and database layer
•	Develop, maintain and improve client web portals using ASP.NET and C# to enable clients to upload data and  view market research and key performance indicator results online 
•	Create T-SQL stored procedures to save and display data in client web portals
•	Create jobs in SQL Server to schedule automated email alerts from client web portals at different time intervals
•	Create, maintain and improve scripts using VBScript to send out email blasts for the purpose of conducting market research
•	Retrieve data from client databases to generate key performance indicator (KPI) reports for the purpose of making business decisions
•	Work with stakeholders to create new web based reports for tracking internal business activities and progress
•	Provide technical documentation for client web portals, internal systems and internal IT processes for the purpose of sharing knowledge between clients and team members

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:
•	Collaborate with clients, project managers, and team members to gather business and technical requirements for new and existing web sites and applications.
•	Create estimates and maintain documentation for initial, existing and new project scope
•	Develop and maintain various database driven web sites and applications using Microsoft and Open Source Technologies that are standards compliant and follow all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle
•	Develop and maintain custom APIs or integrate vendor APIs to exchange and process information between web sites and applications
•	Design, create, maintain and administer various databases in Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Access, MySQL and Oracle 
•	Write T-SQL stored procedures and triggers to enhance functionality and performance of web applications.
•	Deploy, manage and secure multi-tiered applications on development, pre-production and production environments running Windows and Linux operating systems.
•	Perform quality assurance tests and code reviews for new and existing web applications for the purposes of error detection, debugging and improving application performance.
•	Interface with technical, operational and business client areas to troubleshoot and resolve application, security and network/communication issues.

positions.title: .NET SQL Reporting Services Developer (Co-op)
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:
•	Collaborated with testers, developers, programmers, and designers in conceptualizing and developing new and existing software programs and applications.
•	Analyzed and assessed existing business systems and procedures.
•	Writing T-SQL programming scripts to enhance functionality and/or performance of company report generated applications.
•	Executed and monitored software performance tests on new and existing applications and programs for the purposes of correcting errors, isolating areas for improvement, and general debugging
•	Consistently converted, designed and maintained reports in SQL Server Reporting Services for new and existing applications with the intention to show details and summaries of business performance

positions.title: Student Help Desk (Co-op)
positions.description:
Key Responsibilities:
•	Provided answers to student inquiries about computers and college services in person, by phone or by email
•	Demonstrated hands on knowledge about various college services, systems and websites
•	Troubleshooted various hardware and software problems for students and faculty, and assist technologists with repairs and upgrades to computers
